motivation: MSDFT-NOSI spin-multiplet constraints and overlap-weighted correlation matrix, doi:10.1021/acs.jpca.3c04799, equations 12-14
model: spin-adapted CSF-level overlap-weighted residual functional, new approximation
inputs: retained stationary common F/Q 50/50 energy functional, lambda=0.9
basis: one common stationary closed-shell ground, both retained independently optimized ground-orthogonal singlet CSFs, and one closed pair-double at each retained target frame
diagonal: closed determinant functional; open singlet 2 E_mixed - E_triplet
off_diagonal: exact bare projected Slater-Condon between spin-pure CSFs plus overlap times mean of the two residual diagonal functional energies
one_body: physical frozen-core HF one-body operator in the retained embedding; core fixed to original DFT reference
state_assignment: maximum-weight unique normalized overlap with retained target singlet CSFs; overlap >=0.7 and margin >=0.05; retain ground character separately
